What would you like to prepare first?

Broad fixed choices only. Nothing is submitted, uploaded, stored, analyzed by external AI or automatically shared.

Your private checklist

Choose one broad goal to build a checklist.

Prepare step by step

  1. Define the role, schedule, location and training range you can realistically consider.
  2. Prepare a reusable skills list, work-history outline and questions before sharing personal details.
  3. Use official workforce and education routes, then verify deadlines, eligibility, cost and availability directly.
  4. Compare employers and services on factual fit; never pay for a promised job or guaranteed placement.

General job-search and preparation help only—not employment placement, credential verification, career counseling, immigration advice or a promise of work.

Before you contact or choose a service.

  • Confirm current requirements, hours, eligibility, credentials, service area, accessibility, availability and total cost directly.
  • Keep names, narratives, account details, medical identifiers, child information and document text off this public page.
  • Directory appearance, order and paid status are not rankings, referrals, endorsements or proof of fit.
  • You choose whether to copy, print or share this plan; Franklin Navigator does not send it.
